dependencies.required_for: exact primary treatment/control arm IDs and factor vectors
publication-composite scorer contract and oracle independence acceptance
final executable mode set, hardware/model-profile feasibility and raw collection overbuild

optional_secondary_dependencies.rule: not required for the primary contrast; may enter only as a secondary falsification comparator if independently accepted and retained by WP-004 before HOLDOUT

real_power_gate_rule: No dependency may be treated as ACCEPTED from a free-text reference, a syntactically valid hash, a fixture, or a producer assertion. ACCEPTED requires a local machine-readable reviewer attestation at a resolvable review commit, exact artifact digest verification and reviewer_context_id distinct from producer_context_id.
